title: Platform cook list
description: How one platform wants source assets baked. Per-asset metadata says WHAT an asset is; this says how this platform wants it. See docs/PIPELINE.md.

platform.description: Platform this list applies to, matching the CMake platform name in lower case.

level_textures.description: Max dimensions for a brush material baked by the level compiler (tools/compile_level.py), separate from the 'assets.TEXTURE' ceiling: a level pins every one of its materials for its whole lifetime, unlike a standalone resource the game loads one at a time. Absent means unrestricted.

assets.description: Policy per asset class. A class absent from here is skipped entirely on this platform.

format.description: Target encoding. 'source' honours the per-asset format instead of overriding it. 'coverage8' keeps only an alpha channel, against a white ramp, which is what a glyph atlas needs.

budget_bytes.description: Ceiling for all cooked textures together. Validation fails past it.
